Really enjoyed this one. The pixel art is really great, and the soundtrack fits the game perfectly. The gameplay is super fast-paced and very addictive. The bosses I've fought so far have all been really cool, fun, and unique. With each boss, there's always something new to expect, as they all have a wide range of attack patterns. If you're into bullet hell games, I'd definitely recommend giving this game a try!

Fast wave-based vertical shmup. Reach a high-score while you use a screen-clearing bomb, a slow down button, or the special weapon that each of the 4 unlockable ships has.
VOIDRAVE is pure arcade adrenaline. Tight bullet hell combat, gorgeous pixel art and roguelite upgrades make every run a satisfying fight for a higher score.
